title: EventEnvelope
description: Transport wrapper around every payment event. The payload is validated separately against the payload schema referenced by EventType.

eventId.description: Unique event id; the deduplication key.

correlationId.description: Ties together all events of one business flow.

causationId.description: Id of the causing event; null for the root of a flow.

payload.description: Serialized domain event, described by the matching payload schema.
